description: Full lifecycle management of identities is not implemented from creation through revocation.
applicability: Applies when an organization lacks formal processes for managing the complete lifecycle of user identities including provisioning, modification, review, and deprovisioning across all systems and applications.

metadata.detection_notes: Review identity provisioning processes, assess deprovisioning procedures for leavers, verify identity management system capabilities, check for orphaned accounts, evaluate identity lifecycle automation, assess identity governance reviews.
